description: Read the account's usage and spend per API key, newest keys first, 10 keys per page (pass starting_after = the previous answer's next_cursor for the next page; limit up to 1000). Pass period (e.g. 7d, max 30d) for a by-date breakdown, or from + to. Needs a dashboard JWT or a custom-tier superkey; a plain inference key gets PERMISSION_DENIED (403). Needs a Relay credential.

period.description: Time period shorthand, e.g. `7d` or `30d` (max 30 days); adds a by-date breakdown.

starting_after.description: Cursor: the `next_cursor` of the previous page.

name: get_usage
title: Get usage
